title: Multimodal Support in Gen AI Studio Playground
assumptions: The source has no explicit user stories; stories were synthesized from its proposed acceptance criteria.
Models, registered assets, responses, and endpoint statuses are representative mock data; no backend inference or file upload is performed.
The proposed 10 MB file limit is shown as a prototype default; the RFE says PM confirmation is pending.
The standalone prototype focuses on image/audio input. Audio output, microphone capture, PDF input as image, streaming, and multiple attachments are excluded per the strategy.
